North Eastern Region: as-is baseline report

This report checks baseline figures in the eight HLTF reports and the NE Vision Plan 2047 against official statistics. Six of eleven indicators do not match official data, three need a check against the source year, and two match. Key findings: the region's share of national GDP is 2.91% (2022-23), not about 4%; urbanisation is 18.4% (Census 2011), not 21% or 28%; milk availability is about 98 grams per person per day against India's 471; tourism arrivals data match official figures but tourism's share of output is not measured; four NE states have more than 90% of rural specialist doctor posts unfilled.
